client/eslint.config.js.name: Code style checks
client/eslint.config.js.description: Flags risky or untidy browser code while it is being written so problems are caught before they reach the live app.

client/index.html.name: App start page
client/index.html.description: The single page the browser opens first, which then draws every screen of the platform.

client/playwright.config.ts.name: Browser test settings
client/playwright.config.ts.description: Sets up the automatic browser tests that click through the app before a release.

client/playwright.manual.config.ts.name: Manual check settings
client/playwright.manual.config.ts.description: Sets up the by-hand walkthroughs used to confirm that Solutions install and run correctly.

client/playwright.preview.config.ts.name: Preview test settings
client/playwright.preview.config.ts.description: Sets up the browser tests that run against a preview copy of the app before it goes live.

client/postcss.config.js.name: Style preparation
client/postcss.config.js.description: Prepares the app's styling rules so screens look the same in every browser.

client/src/App.tsx.name: App shell and routes
client/src/App.tsx.description: Decides which screen to show for each address in the app and wraps it in the shared navigation frame.

client/src/build-plugins/bifrost-module-.name: App build stand-ins
client/src/build-plugins/bifrost-module-.description: Lets apps built inside the platform load its shared building blocks while they are still being assembled.

client/src/components/ApplicationUpdateS.name: App update notice
client/src/components/ApplicationUpdateS.description: Tells people a new version of an app is being installed and reloads the screen once it is ready.

client/src/components/auth/AuthSetupStep.name: Sign-in setup steps
client/src/components/auth/AuthSetupStep.description: Walks someone through setting up an authenticator app or passkey one step at a time.

client/src/components/auth/AuthTransitio.name: Sign-in transition
client/src/components/auth/AuthTransitio.description: Shows a short finishing-up card while the app completes a sign-in or sign-up step.

client/src/components/dashboard/Dashboar.name: Dashboard summary cards
client/src/components/dashboard/Dashboar.description: Shows the dashboard's headline numbers: how much is available to run and what the automation has returned.

client/src/components/dashboard/Executio.name: Chart text alternative
client/src/components/dashboard/Executio.description: Describes the activity chart in words so screen-reader and touch users get the same picture.

client/src/components/dashboard/Executio.name: Runs over time chart
client/src/components/dashboard/Executio.description: Plots how many runs succeeded or failed over the last day, week or month, with the window switchable.

client/src/components/entity-management/.name: Delete confirmation dialog
client/src/components/entity-management/.description: Asks for a final yes before removing workflows, forms, agents or apps, and warns what else is affected.

client/src/components/entity-management/.name: Bulk delete
client/src/components/entity-management/.description: Removes several selected items at once and remembers what already went, so a retry never deletes twice.

client/src/components/entity-management/.name: Entity access panel
client/src/components/entity-management/.description: Sets which organizations and roles may see and use a workflow, form, agent or app.

client/src/components/entity-management/.name: List load status
client/src/components/entity-management/.description: Shows a short warning when part of a list failed to load, without hiding the rows that did arrive.

client/src/components/entity-management/.name: Management list toolbar
client/src/components/entity-management/.description: Holds the search, filters, sorting and bulk actions above the lists of workflows, forms, agents and apps.

client/src/components/entity-management/.name: List filter menu
client/src/components/entity-management/.description: Opens a panel to narrow a list by resource type, organization or who it is shared with.

client/src/components/entity-management/.name: Management list parts
client/src/components/entity-management/.description: Bundles the shared pieces every management list uses, from the toolbar to the delete prompt.

client/src/components/entity-management/.name: Resource tree table
client/src/components/entity-management/.description: Lists workflows, forms, agents and apps grouped by organization, with actions on each row.

client/src/components/entity-management/.name: Management list records
client/src/components/entity-management/.description: Defines the shared shape of a listed item and how each resource type is labelled and coloured.

client/src/components/EntityLogo.tsx.name: Entity logo
client/src/components/EntityLogo.tsx.description: Shows an item's chosen logo picture, falling back to its type icon when none is set.

client/src/components/entityLogoVersions.name: Logo refresh
client/src/components/entityLogoVersions.description: Notifies every open view when a logo changes so the new picture appears without a page reload.

client/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx.name: Screen crash catcher
client/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx.description: Catches a screen crash and shows a friendly message with a way back, instead of a blank page.

client/src/components/execution/executio.name: Run detail styling
client/src/components/execution/executio.description: Sets the spacing and layout shared by every screen that shows a single run.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: Run activity feed
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Shows a readable stream of what a run actually did, leaving technical detail to the logs.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: Run context strip
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Shows a compact line of facts about when, where and for whom a run happened.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: AI usage per run
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Shows how many tokens and how much money an AI-powered run used.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: Run context help
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Explains the extra facts attached to a run, such as which identity and organization it ran as.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: Stop and rerun prompts
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Confirms stopping a run that is still working, or starting a fresh copy of it from the beginning.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: Run result tabs
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Switches a run's side panel between its result, the input it was given and its logs.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: Run logs
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Shows every log line from a run with live updates, filtering and copy-to-clipboard.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: Run details list
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Lists the facts about a run: which workflow ran, who started it, when, and how it ended.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: Run detail bar
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Puts the key facts about a run in a single row above its results.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: Run page header
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Titles a run page with its status and the actions available for that run.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: Run read error
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Says a run's details could not be loaded and offers to try again.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: Run results
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Shows what a finished run returned, formatted for reading instead of as raw data.

client/src/components/execution/Executio.name: Run section heading
client/src/components/execution/Executio.description: Gives each section of a run page the same heading, whether it opens in the page or a side panel.
